transcript.note: Round 3, resolving the last two winding rejections (Waterloo(44) and its crossing point(105)). Round 2 was wrong about why: Lambeth North(45) and 105 are not the same point, they only round to the same normalised 0-1000 coordinate; in the raw projection 45 sits a fraction west and north of 105. So collapsing them onto one cell deleted 45 from 105's fan and made the two fans different lengths - unmatchable. Read the actual reference bearings instead: Waterloo needs the cyclic fan [104, 45, 105, 21, 102, 107], i.e. 45 must be swept just BEFORE 105, and 105 needs [8, 26, 44, 45], i.e. 45 must lie west of it, past Waterloo. Both are satisfied by putting 45 at [46,24] and 105 at [47,24] - the exact reverse of the round 1 pair, which had them the wrong way round. This keeps Waterloo-Lambeth North vertical on col46 and makes 45-105 horizontal on row24, so the hv count is unchanged, and it removes the deliberate collide from round 2. No other point moved.

transcript.note: Round 2. Round 1 was accepted (hv 0->50, cross/vtxOn/collide all 0, grid 112x113 -> 80x106) but lost orderFlip 0->6, so this round is purely about putting the compass back. Four of the six flips were one mistake: North Acton(31) has gy 601 but I had slotted it into the ~621 row band at row39, which put it south of Moorgate, Edgware Road, Liverpool Street and Baker Street when it is north of all four. Moved it to row43, between Baker St(603) and Warren St's crossing(598). The fifth flip was Ealing Broadway(53) sitting one row south of Bond Street(22) when it is fractionally north; the sixth was the crossing point 110 sitting one row north of Holborn(69) when it is fractionally south. Both are sub-unit differences that the 0-1000 export rounds away, so I resolved them into exact ties on row38, which the metric treats as free: 53 -> [16,38] and 110 -> [17,38]. That also converts 53-110 from a vertical into a horizontal, and the pair drops off row17 so Park Royal(51)-110 stays vertical there. Moving 31 cost the 31-110 horizontal, so I recovered one elsewhere by pulling Baker Street(90) west to col32 to line it up vertically with Edgware Road(25) - checked that the Bakerloo/Circle fan at Baker Street, Bond Street, Oxford Circus and the 106 crossing all keep their winding order. Net hv unchanged at 50.
